# Real Database Integration Testing with Testcontainers

Running true integration tests against real ephemeral databases (PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka) spawned via Testcontainers.

## Invariants
- USE_EPHEMERAL_DOCKER_CONTAINERS_FOR_TESTS
- CLEAN_DATABASE_BETWEEN_TEST_SUITES
- PARALLEL_TEST_ISOLATION_VIA_RANDOM_PORTS
